text_block_list.text:
The Mecha Umamusume ST-2, invented by 
Doctor of Engineering Sugar Lights. Its 
appearance was...
The day to reveal it has finally arrived.

Turnout at Tokyo Racecourse was modest. 
Given ST-2's readiness, we kept the 
exhibition limited.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer, I'm going to run the best 
race I possibly can right now.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Several "Upgrade Exams." A few glitches 
discovered during them have yet to be 
resolved, however...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Even so... as much as I can.
choice_data_list: Yes, please go and enjoy yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: "Have fun, huh? Yeah, all right. Got it."
(Zwoosh)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It's not a race day today. I'll just go 
feel the wind as my heart desires.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Well then—here goes! Tohh!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, Mecha Uma Musume ST-2 has begun 
to run.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It may look mechanical, but inside, it is 
a state-of-the-art robot that harbors the 
heart of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Just a little more... can I keep going?! 
Just a little bit further...)
(Psssssh...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Kgh...! No, but... anything more than 
this is...)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, she stumbled a bit, but she's 
alright. According to our info, she's 
still unfinished, but—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to run this much is a 
massive leap forward for robotics!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, this is great progress. However... I 
am still only halfway there...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
And so, becoming one with ST-2, the wind 
rushing past feels amazing. It feels 
amazing, but...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I still haven't reached the 
view I've always dreamed of...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I want to run faster. Even faster...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Safely across the finish line! Everyone, 
please give a grand round of applause for 
ST-2 and Dr. Sugar Lights!
(Clap clap clap...!)

After circling the track once, ST-2 
returned, and we all went out to welcome 
her.
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Everyone... thank you, too.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
And so, being able to pull off the 
unveiling somehow was all thanks to 
everyone.
(Bzz)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I would have liked to refine 
it a bit more, but..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's quite difficult, isn't it? However, I 
believe we achieved a fair amount of 
success.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Just making it this far is 
amazing in itself."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A tower that cannot reach the heavens for 
now. Yet, the day will surely come when it 
pierces the sky."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I intend to continue research 
and development going forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, updates never truly end. Nothing 
wrong with the OS, so have some faith.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I am... expecting great things.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I have no intention of 
stopping here. I must... keep moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
By the way everyone, I have one last favor 
to ask.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I want to give shape to the 
fact that we all met like this. To the 
fact that we became a team.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, the ST-2 is not a machine 
built solely for running.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
A versatile machine capable of any 
movement. And now—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I can also sing with my voice, and I can 
dance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Able to sing and dance... Which means...
choice_data_list: Can we do a live show?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yes. During my active racing days, I 
rarely had the chance to stand on the 
stage, but...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I want to experience it— the exhilaration 
of standing at the center of the live 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Of course, without an audience is fine. 
Even if it's just to show Trainer my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmm, if that is the case――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, no helping it. Guess I'll see this 
through with you to the end.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. Though development on 
the ST-2 is still only halfway done...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Let's express it with all our might— the 
joy of striving toward tomorrow!
